newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec to hold briefing on non-bank affiliates.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec to hold briefing on non-bank affiliates.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would hold a news conference at 3.40 p.m. (0640 GMT) on its non-bank affiliates.

Industry sources said financial support to ailing non-bank affiliates has been discussed by Nikko, the third-biggest Japanese broker, as Nomura Securities Co Ltd, the biggest, and Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, the second biggest, took action earlier this year to help bail out their non-bank affiliates.
Nikko vice-president Masao Yuki told reporters in October that the company was considering financial support to several of its financially troubled non-bank affiliates.
However, he said one of the troubled units was jointly owned by Asahi Bank Ltd, and that it would take time to work out a plan.
